parts.text: Do this in three separate steps, one URL per step, reading each page with the URL context tool before moving to the next: step 1 read https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains and give its title; step 2 read https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2606.txt and give its title; step 3 read https://nodejs.org/en/about/previous-releases and name the current LTS line. One line per step.
